about: The ghosted head for the exhibit's object in the hand: the as-built king's head, solid, inside the First Time lion's head, drawn translucent. Written by render/export_heads.py; read by apps/exhibit.
frame: glTF's: metres, +x east, +y up, -z north, centred on `centre` (project metres: +x east, +y north, +z up)
standin: Both heads are visual stand-ins (Meshy models), cut from the statues as the renders fit them to the Sphinx's footprint. Nothing of their form is a measurement; the enlargement is read off the two stand-ins.
